asr.full_text: Music For a good-looking movie, drama, science, music video, web film or web series, along with good art skills, good story is also needed. as they can be more expensive, they need to have the best of the best to support their art and technology. And in a nutshell, the great view of the shooting site is to be enjoyed from most audiences. Despite the lack of such a great view of the shooting spot, the local population still keeps all their hopes high. The Dhamraya film valley, which was once the home of the English and Indian film, has become a central home of the city international films located in New Delhi. Many people have left this place behind in the Euro-group. On 1st July the city opened for film-shooting. There's a studio and floor in the film-city. They are named King Badanti Media Bhakti Denname. Film-City is present in every industry. Like this, we all have in this place only such homes, individual parks, which are also called shooting spots or a place for the public to shoot. So I was worried about whether any planning could take place in this place. With so many facilities in a single spot like this, about 12 years ago from this spot I have been thinking and going around after taking a proposal of such a place and I have submitted at different places. proposals, in many directions while submitting it. Nobody was responding in any way, Finally, the Chairman of Euro Group, ASMR Haidar, After seeing that proposal, Haidar initially, entered into an interest to finance this project. We had proposed that project After three years we postponed Slowly Asker film city has got a better shape The houses in the city of Dhaka They can get only props and building Others exterior or landscape or parks They are available in different places We can go in for outdoor activities but we also discussed how to make outdoor facility. We also created props of various kind and furniture as well. We are putting cable inside the wire floor in order to be light through the cable, in all points, the line 3 phase is there which is used for the male-female socket connection. And we also have the rainy machine, which can record the rain work where ever you find rain I have a chroma studio here here you do your work with chroma Then the bigger floor as if the hall room for the office, there is only one office setup corporate looks like office two table or chairs or our office established practice We have a proper office setup where office can be sequenced The hospital's items hospital is very good ICU,CCU, Doctor chambers, ward, props and sets. And this is a clean lake here. A separate package of the restaurant as you can see here is the set up. We have decided that the restaurant will only be used for shooting. The middle class families shooting here has shoot, there are sets for them If poor families are going to shoot, they have a hut All that we need to establish a gulp All that must be the sub-win, all that we need to link up To establish the gulp We used filmct to do all that There are big desires for a more management of film valley We can make it more specific with bigger facilities and facilities, we can also put an interior to some place to use the whole house. Now when it comes to the train, we need to take the shots of it from outside, Maybe, a train should be from within, and we do take a look at some of the bogeys on the train. But because of the heat, the variation to the ground isn't coming out to the ground. We also want to arrange some such training sets. Once we pay them the houses of the whole thing. When we had a shortage of people, we couldn't come here, hence they asked for our help. So, I decided to not take up my own responsibilities. I took over their houses, that took $1,550 from the association, I came on top of it, and developed my knowledge, which had more facilities for everyone, nothing was completely free for people. Thanks to these houses, we were able to earn more knowledge, we took come here. due to gaining the recognition and knowledge we will increase the awareness in public. For example, the landscape we have is outdoor. An outdoor item if taken out by a client, then people of the same region can shoot from wherever they are. One more thing I want to mention, 24 hour generator system, they would be able to shoot. What I also want to emphasize is that there is 24 hour generator system and electricity available. Since we're promoting the generation system we don't pay any rent for a free one. We will be spending on the generator if we get a custom-baulder. Next to the shooting stand, we have now seen the place of Sandraji as well. We will try to open up a new film cinema for the world and to use it for people from different countries to come. The location of the film city is located near the shooting complex in Chundharji. We studied the film city, even after coming from Ramoji and Universe Studios. I began to take into account the technical aspects of the land. And tried to find out if things can be done in that particular city, that is one of the first cities in any other country. When we saw the issues of film cities, how they are affected by the budget, and their needs, also looked for help to fix them, in a budget. There are two things that we need here. High tech support, aesthetic value and also and natural setting will also be required There will be nature, there will be water, the sky, flowers, greenery, soil All these things will also be needed
